'''Herkin''' was a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] stationed with a unit of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] in the city of [[Mos Shuuta/Legends|Mos Shuuta]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Herkin had illegal connections with [[Teemo/Legends|Teemo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and along with a group of Teemo's [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] thugs chased a group of adventurers into [[Landing Bay Aurek]], where the adventurers stole the ''[[Krayt Fang]]'', a ship belonging to [[Trex]], one of Teemo's employees.
